integrity: The invariant vector law and limiting constants follow from the displayed proof and were checked numerically using the enclosed reproducibility script. No independent audit or formal machine proof is represented.
scientific_limitations: The two sharp endpoint limits concern the fixed-radius-origin coefficient after radius tends to zero for each fixed contraction c. They do not constitute a joint scaling limit. Uniqueness of the interior optimum is unproved. Independent priority assessment has not been performed.
title: Endpoint laws for the stationary radius of partially reset three-dimensional Brownian motion
